dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions with COPY/REPLACING using // delimiters, LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM, and MCPAREA/MCPDATA copybooks typical of the ORCA system
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM PIC X(256)

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - monthly billing comment editing for transferred/self-pay receipts (転帰・自費請求)
purpose.summary: This program (ORCR0435) is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It processes monthly billing receipt files (RECE41, RECE44, RECE45 indexed files) to create comment-edited output files for transferred/self-pay receipt claims. It manages job control via ORCSJOB, handles cancellation processing, and reads/writes multiple indexed receipt data files.

notable_features: Multiple indexed file I/O with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
CALL to ORCSJOB job management subprogram
CALL to ORCSJOBKANRI DB control subprogram
REDEFINES with OCCURS for month/day lookup tables
20 COPY statements for modular copybook inclusion
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (flat file based)
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in Japanese EUC (decoded as latin-1), causing mojibake in comments. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Truncated at 16000 chars but sufficient structure visible for confident classification.
